name: Brydan Xavier
title: Director and Principal Psychologist
description: Director and Principal Psychologist. Works with adults navigating complex trauma, neurodivergence, gender and sexuality. Mostly therapy, including EMDR and EMDR 2.0, alongside Autism, ADHD and WPATH-aligned assessments. Uses Schema Therapy, ACT, CBT, DBT; trauma-informed, LGBTIQASB+ inclusive and gender-affirming, kink-aware, HIV-friendly. Offers sexual health and intimacy counselling. Limited capacity, accepting applications for 2027.
specialties: complex trauma, EMDR, EMDR 2.0, schema therapy, neurodivergence, gender and sexuality, WPATH assessments, autism/ADHD assessment, sexual health and intimacy, kink-aware, HIV-friendly, National Redress Scheme
identity: 'Neurodivergent, queer, and not pretending otherwise'; 'Brydan is AuDHD ... and a member of the LGBTIQASB+ community'

name: Minh Anh Nguyen
title: Psychologist
description: Psychologist, online on Wednesdays, from 7 October 2026. Background includes close work with trans and gender-diverse clients; works within a neuroaffirming, trauma-informed and identity-affirming frame. Works with 'Queer and trans people who want a therapist who does not need educating', adult children of migrants and the Asian diaspora. Special interests include trauma, minority stress, gender and sexuality. Works in English and Vietnamese.
specialties: trauma, gender and sexuality, minority stress, ADHD and autism in adults, Asian diaspora, adult children of migrants, internalised racism, disordered eating, CBT, ACT, DBT
identity: 'a second-generation Vietnamese Australian, with lived experience of late-identified neurodivergence'
